title: cli-contract.json
description: A tool's settings for @edspencer/cli-conformance: which checks apply, and why any don't. Every check the runner has must be listed, apart from the opt-in update checks.

name.description: The product's name, as serve's first line says it: `Local Review`.

bin.description: Which bin to run, when the package has more than one.

timeoutMs.description: How long each command may take. Default 15000.

env.description: Extra environment for every command; null removes a variable. {home} and {tmp} are filled in.

args.description: Starts it in the foreground. {port}, {home} and {tmp} are filled in.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the first line and /api/health. Default 30000.

update.description: Settings for the opt-in update checks.

runtimeFile.description: Where the tool looks for its runtime.json, for update-busy: {home}/.tool/runtime.json. {home} and {tmp} are filled in.

serviceInstall.description: How update-service and update-rollback install the service. Default ["service", "install", "--port", "{port}"].

timeoutMs.description: How long each update command may take. Default 300000.

skip.description: Why this check doesn't apply yet.
